Vizor's liquid metal effect is ported from Paper Shaders (Apache-2.0, see
`LICENSE` and `NOTICE`). Ported and modified for Flutter:

- `shaders/liquid_metal.frag`: the liquid-metal fragment shader (image mode)
- `lib/src/core/widgets/liquid_metal.dart`: `processLiquidMetalImage`
  (`toProcessedLiquidMetal`)
